name: BT Business / BT Global
product_focus: Managed SD-WAN using Cisco, VMware/Broadcom, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Meraki
evidence_summary: BT source evidences managed SD-WAN and access to vendor platforms including Cisco, VMware/Broadcom, Fortinet and Palo Alto.
cost_model: Quote-based managed service; includes access, CPE, vendor stack and service tier options.
key_differentiators: UK market leader for managed SD-WAN with deep access circuit ownership and field engineering capability.
Multi-vendor platform support (Cisco, VMware/Broadcom, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Meraki) gives buyers platform choice within one managed service.
Strong global SD-WAN and SASE delivery via BT Global for multinational requirements.
best_fit_for: UK enterprises wanting a single supplier for SD-WAN platform, access circuits, security and field operations.
Multinational organisations with a UK headquarters needing global delivery via BT Global.
Buyers prioritising underlay accountability and field engineering depth alongside SD-WAN delivery.
watch_outs: Platform choice and packaging vary; buyers should confirm which vendor platform is being proposed and why.
DIY/self-managed model is not BT's primary positioning.
Co-managed model and customer control boundaries should be confirmed via RACI and portal demo.
verification_notes: Capability matrix sourced from Netify internal vendor research (May 2026). Status grades reflect public source evidence only. Confirm via RFP. Qualitative fields (differentiators, best fit, watch-outs) are Netify editorial synthesis based on the evidence summary and capability profile; review before publishing.
